reviewer_notes: Full 8-direction minion v2 atlas contains 96 generated 64px rows: 8 directions x 2 teams x 3 minion types x move/attack.
Blue and red melee, ranged, and siege minions remain visually distinct with teal-blue arcane energy for blue and red-purple rift energy for red.
Direction groups are readable across south, south-east, east, north-east, north, north-west, west, and south-west; side/back/front silhouettes differ enough for gameplay readability.
Move rows show readable looping motion and attack rows show distinct weapon, projectile, swing, cannon flash, recoil, or recovery poses.
The atlas was cleaned after generation; strict validation reports zero chroma residue warnings and a custom green-residue pass reports zero remaining low-blue green pixels.
